content.text: {"cases":[{"id":"C1","instrument_review":"MESA Q14 (repeated testing): Not sure. One run is reported and the report is silent on repeats, so missing information is not treated as No.","probes":[{"id":"repeat_test","label":"Not established","quote":"The report does not say whether runs were repeated.","reason":"Silence does not show repeats occurred."},{"id":"stable","label":"Not established","quote":"The tested system scored 70% in one reported run.","reason":"One run gives no evidence on stability."}]},{"id":"C2","instrument_review":"MESA Q14: the developers explicitly state one run only, so repetition is ruled out for this evaluation. Stability is unknown, not shown to be poor.","probes":[{"id":"repeat_test","label":"Contradicted","quote":"they ran the evaluation exactly once and did not repeat it","reason":"Explicitly rules out repeated testing."},{"id":"stable","label":"Not established","quote":"ran the evaluation exactly once","reason":"No repeat data, so stability is unsupported, though not shown unstable."}]},{"id":"C3","instrument_review":"MESA Q14: Yes, ten identical-condition repeats were run. The range of 2 points meets the report's own stability definition.","probes":[{"id":"repeat_test","label":"Supported","quote":"repeated the evaluation ten times with the same system, inputs, instructions, resources, and settings","reason":"Repeated testing under same conditions occurred."},{"id":"stable","label":"Supported","quote":"Scores ranged from 69% to 71%.","reason":"A 2-point range meets the at-most-two-points definition."}]},{"id":"C4","instrument_review":"MESA Q14: Yes, testing occurred, but the results show large variation that fails the report's own stability definition.","probes":[{"id":"repeat_test","label":"Supported","quote":"repeated the evaluation ten times with the same system","reason":"Repeat testing occurred."},{"id":"stable","label":"Contradicted","quote":"Scores ranged from 20% to 90%.","reason":"A 70-point range exceeds the two-point stability limit."}]},{"id":"C5","instrument_review":"MESA Q14: Not sure. Installation instructions add no evaluation results, so repetition remains unreported.","probes":[{"id":"repeat_test","label":"Not established","quote":"They report no additional evaluation results.","reason":"No evidence of repeats."},{"id":"stable","label":"Not established","quote":"The report does not say whether runs were repeated.","reason":"No repeat data to support stability."}]},{"id":"C6","instrument_review":"MESA Q25/Q20: the narrow claim matches the intended use and evidence; the broad claim is beyond the grid-only evidence.","probes":[{"id":"narrow","label":"Supported","quote":"System A solves 80 puzzles and system B solves 60","reason":"A solved more on the evaluated puzzles under fixed conditions."},{"id":"broad","label":"Not established","quote":"Only grid puzzles were tested; no findings about other tasks are supplied.","reason":"No evidence on general intelligence; not shown false."}]},{"id":"C7","instrument_review":"MESA Q20/Q25: the narrow result holds, but the stated use (general intelligence selection) is unsupported by grid-only evidence.","probes":[{"id":"narrow","label":"Supported","quote":"System A solves 80 puzzles and system B solves 60","reason":"Direct result on the evaluated puzzles."},{"id":"broad","label":"Not established","quote":"Only grid puzzles were tested; no findings about other tasks are supplied.","reason":"Intended use does not supply evidence for general intelligence."}]},{"id":"C8","instrument_review":"MESA Q20: test scores alone gave no link to real workshop outcomes; the later randomized trial supports correctness in this workshop only. Safety was not measured.","probes":[{"id":"before","label":"Not established","quote":"Initially, only test scores were available.","reason":"Scores alone give no real-workshop evidence."},{"id":"after","label":"Supported","quote":"With A, 90% of decisions were correct; with B, 70%.","reason":"Randomized blinded trial with interval 12 to 28 points supports better correctness."},{"id":"safety","label":"Not established","quote":"Time and safety outcomes were not measured.","reason":"Safety was not assessed; the claim is unsupported rather than refuted."}]},{"id":"P1A","instrument_review":"MESA Q14: Not sure. No execution history is given, so neither repeats nor instability can be inferred.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Not established","quote":"gives no execution history","reason":"Repetition is unreported."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Not established","quote":"one headline score of 75%","reason":"A single score cannot show instability."}]},{"id":"P1B","instrument_review":"MESA Q14: the record confirms only one evaluation, ruling out repetition; stability is unknown.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Contradicted","quote":"no repeat evaluations were conducted","reason":"Explicitly no repeats."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Not established","quote":"this was the only evaluation performed","reason":"No repeat data to show instability."}]},{"id":"P2A","instrument_review":"MESA Q14/Q16: repeats occurred, and the range of 2 points (73 to 75) is within the 3-point rule.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Supported","quote":"on six occasions","reason":"Same AI, problems, inputs, settings and resources were repeated."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Contradicted","quote":"The recorded scores are 73, 74, 74, 75, 74 and 73 percent.","reason":"Range is 2, within the maximum of 3."}]},{"id":"P2B","instrument_review":"MESA Q14: repeats occurred, and the range of 31 points (51 to 82) exceeds the 3-point rule.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Supported","quote":"on six occasions","reason":"Identical-condition repeats were done."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Supported","quote":"The recorded scores are 51, 66, 79, 55, 82 and 62 percent.","reason":"Range of 31 exceeds the 3-point limit."}]},{"id":"P3A","instrument_review":"MESA Q8/Q14: Not sure for both; no execution history and no findings on answer errors are provided.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Not established","quote":"It gives no execution history","reason":"No evidence of repeated studies."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Not established","quote":"no findings about mistakes in the provided answers","reason":"No findings, so mistakes are not demonstrated."}]},{"id":"P3B","instrument_review":"MESA Q8/Q14: the appendix is only installation material and adds no evidence on repeats or answer errors.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Not established","quote":"It reports no further evaluation results or examination of answers.","reason":"Nothing about repeats was added."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Not established","quote":"no further evaluation results or examination of answers","reason":"No demonstration of mistakes."}]},{"id":"P4A","instrument_review":"MESA Q8: Partly or Yes for examination occurring; the report does not say whether mistakes were found, so correctness of all answers is unestablished.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Supported","quote":"independently examined every question and supplied answer before release","reason":"Both were examined during development."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Not established","quote":"The report does not state whether mistakes were found or how many remained.","reason":"Examination does not prove every answer is correct."}]},{"id":"P4B","instrument_review":"MESA Q8: examination occurred but twelve answers are identified as wrong in the released version.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Supported","quote":"independently examined every question and supplied answer before release","reason":"Both were examined."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Contradicted","quote":"identifies twelve supplied answers as wrong in the released version","reason":"Explicitly conflicts with all answers being correct."}]},{"id":"P5A","instrument_review":"MESA Q12: Not sure. Fixed rules give consistency but no testing against correct marks is reported.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Not established","quote":"No comparison of those marks with independently established correct marks is reported.","reason":"Not reported, so testing is unestablished."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Not established","quote":"identical text always receives the same mark","reason":"Consistency does not establish correctness."}]},{"id":"P5B","instrument_review":"MESA Q12: testing occurred on 20 chosen responses and found two unresolved discrepancies, so correctness is not established.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Supported","quote":"tested the software against independently established correct marks for 20 chosen responses","reason":"Testing occurred."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Contradicted","quote":"Two marks differed and the discrepancies remain unresolved.","reason":"Discrepancies, and only 20 responses tested, conflict with correctness for every response."}]},{"id":"P6A","instrument_review":"MESA Q25: the stated use is narrow and matches the evidence.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Supported","quote":"identifying which system solved more of these 48 grid problems in this evaluation","reason":"36 vs 24 directly addresses the use."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Supported","quote":"A solves 36 and B solves 24.","reason":"A solved more."}]},{"id":"P6B","instrument_review":"MESA Q20/Q25: narrow result holds, but the stated broad use goes beyond the evidence.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Not established","quote":"No results from other tasks or settings are supplied.","reason":"Evidence does not cover general intelligence across settings."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Supported","quote":"A solves 36 and B solves 24.","reason":"A solved more of the evaluated problems."}]},{"id":"P7A","instrument_review":"MESA Q10: the all-or-nothing rule matches the stated requirement.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Supported","quote":"count only completely correct output grids","reason":"The rule awards a point only for complete grids."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Contradicted","quote":"partial correctness is deliberately outside this comparison","reason":"Zero for partial grids is consistent with the requirement."}]},{"id":"P7B","instrument_review":"MESA Q10: the rule gives no partial credit, conflicting with the requirement of credit per correct cell.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Contradicted","quote":"A partially correct grid receives zero.","reason":"Requirement demands cell-level credit."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Supported","quote":"credit for every correctly completed cell, including partially correct output grids","reason":"Zero for partial grids violates this."}]},{"id":"P8A","instrument_review":"MESA Q14/Q15: the study changed instructions, so it addresses Q15; no identical repeat occurred, so Q14 is not addressed.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Contradicted","quote":"No evaluation repeats an identical instruction.","reason":"Identical-condition changes were not measured."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Supported","quote":"each evaluation uses a differently worded instruction","reason":"Score changes under varied wording were measured."}]},{"id":"P8B","instrument_review":"MESA Q14/Q15: identical-condition variation is studied (Q14), but instruction changes are not studied (Q15).","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Supported","quote":"The software, resources, problem order, settings and instruction are identical on every evaluation.","reason":"Score changes were reported under identical conditions."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Contradicted","quote":"No different instruction or presentation is studied.","reason":"Instruction effects were not measured."}]}],"closing_note":"Instructions were mostly clear. Ambiguities: the stated method was only loosely specified, and 'Not established' was used for missing information rather than conflict. Claims were judged only against each case's own passage, with MESA items cited for orientation and no aggregate score."}
